scope: Only current merged leader mainboard signals with the user keep-tag; current membership and prior descriptive outcome review bias acknowledged
entry: Signal close confirmation -> next official exchange session OPEN only. No same-day buy/sell. No requeue of skipped signals.
sizing: Each entry gross plus buy fees <= 50% of equity immediately before this buy, also <= spendable cash; 100-share buy lots; max2 distinct codes. No repeated same-code position.
priorities: Signal_date ascending then code ascending. At open process known opening exits first, then opening buys. Intraday exits cannot fund already-passed opening buys. No future returns used.
initial_stop: 5% below actual entry adjusted open; raw execution and share ledger.
profit: When prior-session high reaches entry*1.10: stop=max(previous stop, entry+0.70*(prior high-entry)); never lowered; update after close only.
tplus1: Buy-day stop touches create pending exit for next eligible session, no same-day sale.
horizon: 60 exchange sessions including buy day. Planned close exit at day60; if down-limit close cannot fill, carry pending sell. No year-end reset or forced liquidation merely for reporting.
queue: Opening buy at upper price limit skipped conservatively. Sell at lower-limit open is not credited before buys; if intraday unlock high>lower, estimate sale at lower in intraday phase. Full-day locked lower carries pending.
stop_fill: Known pre-open stop: open below stop -> open fill subject to limit queue. Otherwise intraday low touch -> estimate standing-stop price. Daily estimates do not certify queue fills.

fees.commission_scope: both sides, includes brokerage/exchange handling component; do not double charge

actions: Original price cash/share ledger; record-day entitlement at close, ex-date receivable, actual pay-date cash; stock bonus/capitalization listings only on supplied listing date. Raw preclose discontinuities while held reconciled with source actions. Missing dates/rights/subscription unresolved -> audit failure, no certified result.
dividend_tax: Cash plus bonus-share face-value taxable base; holding<=1calendar month20%, >1month<=1year10%, >1year exempt; current liability reserved from investable cash until final withholding. Face-value-dependent bonus shares require verification.
marks: Cash plus listed shares and unlisted share receivables at raw mark plus cash receivables minus dividend tax liability. Genuine halt uses last quoted mark and separately logs stale valuation; unknown active data fail closed.
extremes: Do not delete future winners>=100%; prior extreme removal was descriptive only.
comparison: New open-entry chronological account, not comparable to prior ideal-close independent-signal means.
